Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success.

We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience.

As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.

Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential

Responsibilities

Join our team as a Property Field Inspection Claim Specialist and showcase your expertise in handling accident and weather-related claims for homeowners, commercial properties, and large losses.

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled professional to contribute to our dynamic team. State Farm is on the cutting edge with the use of technology to support claim employees in developing enhanced skillsets to support and protect our policyholders. Not Human or Digital. Human + Digital, working together. You will be the first point of contact to meet with our insureds, explain coverage, estimate damages, and help them through the claims process while providing Remarkable service.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct on-site inspections and assessments of property damages for both residential and commercial claims
• Collaborate with policyholders, insurance agents, and other involved parties to gather information and resolve claims efficiently
• May occasionally require interacting with parties who express strong emotions or concerns about ongoing inspections or claim resolutions
• Provide exceptional customer service throughout the claims process, addressing inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally
• Gather necessary evidence, document findings, and prepare detailed reports to support the claims handling process
• Investigate and adjust both personal and commercial property claims with exposures up to $500,000
• Evaluate coverage and policy terms to determine the validity of claims and ensure compliance with local regulations
• Negotiate and settle claims within the authorized limits, considering policy provisions, industry standards, and company guidelines

Where you'll work: This position is located in Tri Cities, WA. Competitive candidates should reside within one of the listed zip codes and will service this same territory:

99105, 99159, 99169, 99301, 99320, 99323, 99324, 99326, 99328, 99329, 99330, 99335, 99336, 99337, 99338, 99341, 99343, 99345, 99346, 99347, 99348, 99350, 99352, 99353, 99354, 99359, 99360, 99361, 99362, 99363, 99371, 99401, 99402, 99403.

This is a Remote-Field position in which you will work from home and utilize a mobile office/vehicle for in-person appointments. Although the primary work location is in the field, with a commutable distance from home, there will be opportunities for virtual work to be completed at home. Additionally, there may be occasions where you will be required to travel outside your assigned area to assist in other territories.

Hours of operation are continually evaluated and may change based on business need. Successful candidates are able and willing to work flexible schedules and may be asked to work overtime and/or irregular hours.

Qualifications

Competitive candidates must demonstrate:

• Ability to investigate problems, evaluate information, and make well-supported decisions
• Ability to interpret detailed policies, guidelines, or technical information and apply them accurately to real-world situations
• Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar concepts, processes, and terminology and apply that knowledge accurately in practical situations
• Ability to effectively interact with policyholders, agents, and other stakeholders to move claims forward efficiently
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills to handle difficult/emotional conversations with a customer-minded focus
• Detail-oriented with strong organizational and analytical skills
• Proficiency in using mobile/desktop tools to document and support claims both in the field and remotely
• Physical agility to allow for: walking; bending, reaching, kneeling, squatting, stooping, frequent lifting, carrying, unfolding, and climbing a ladder; ability to utilizing appropriate equipment in accordance with safety guidelines to traverse roofs at various heights and pitches for inspection of both residential and commercial structures; ability to crawl in tight spaces to gather information needed during the adjustment of a claim.
• May be required to complete Rope and Harness Safety Training
• A valid driver's license is required

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field such as Risk Management, Insurance, Business, Construction Management or a similar discipline
• Customer service experience (e.g., assisting customers, handling inquiries/concerns professionally, communicating clearly and empathetically), demonstrating transferable skills that support client interactions in a Claims environment
• Understanding of property insurance concepts, including coverage fundamentals and general claim handling practices
• Baseline knowledge of residential and commercial building construction and building components/materials
Familiarity with water mitigation principles and inspection processes
• Working knowledge of Xactimate and XactContents

Additional Details:

• Employees must successfully complete all required training, including applicable proficiency, licensing exam(s), Motor Vehicle Recrd (MVR) checks, and background checks required of various state(s).
• State Farm recently implemented new pre-employment assessments. Candidates that have previously taken an assessment may be asked to participate in additional testing.

Our Benefits

Because work-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45-hour work week!

• Potential starting salary range: $69,398.62 - $99,000.00 / annually

• Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience
• High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience

• Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary

At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!

• Get Paid! On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus.
• Stay Well! Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more!
• Develop and Grow! Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring.
• Plan Ahead! Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union!
• Take a Little “You” Time! You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you!
• Give Back! We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund.
• Finish Strong! Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary.

Visit our State Farm Careers page for more information on our benefits, locations, and the hiring process of joining the State Farm team!

我們正在尋覓人才協助我們帶領 Coupang 台灣拓展業務。這是個難得的機會，一同參與 Coupang 在台灣的成長，打造一個讓我們的顧客自問「沒有 Coupang，我該怎麼過活？」的世界。

職務名稱: Catalog Operation Management Specialist 電商選品專案組長

職位簡介
我們正在尋找一位反應敏銳、能獨立作業的選品專案組長，負責推動專案目標並管理一個 5 至 10 人的小團隊。這份工作不僅僅是執行檢查清單，我們更需要一位能全權負責工作流程、洞察細節，並確保團隊維持高生產力與準確性的關鍵人才。

您將成為產品數據分析與流程改善的技術核心。我們希望您是一位具備主動積極特質的人（Self-starter）——能夠在極少指導下處理複雜任務、主動培訓他人，並在發現瓶頸時找出更好的解決方案。

核心重點：
• 營運所有權：管理每日人力配置，確保團隊達成目標。
• 品質管控：維持數據準確性，並在不犧牲品質的前提下提升產出速度。
• 獨立分析：自主進行產品研究與屬性對比。
• 流程優化：診斷現行標準作業程序 (SOP) 的問題，並提出優化的解決方案。

主要職責
• 團隊領導與自主管理：以高度責任感帶領 5 至 10 人的團隊；獨立管理專案人力分配與日常營運，確保專案成功。
• 績效與考勤管理：監控團隊出勤狀況並進行績效考核，確保所有成員持續達到或超越團隊標準。
• 品質與產能管控：監督團隊產出的準確性與效率；主動識別瓶頸，並推動持續改善以確保高質量的數據產出。
• 培訓與發展：設計並執行內部培訓計劃，以提升團隊的專業技能與作業效率。
• 主管支援：在極少監督的情況下，高效完成主管交辦任務，支援部門整體目標。

職位要求
• 產品專業知識：具備強大的產品敏銳度，熟悉品類屬性；能夠獨立進行線上/線下的產品分析與競品研究。
• 邏輯思考與適應力：具備嚴謹的邏輯推理能力，能處理複雜數據；作為自驅型人才，需能適應變化，並在動態環境中帶領團隊達成目標。
• 高度自主與責任感：證明自己具備獨立作業及在壓力下解決問題的能力；能在多任務環境中有效安排優先順序，確保如期達成目標。
• 流程診斷與優化：熟悉 SOP 運作，並具備分析與診斷工作流問題的能力，能獨立提出建設性的優化策略。
• 電商熱忱：對電子商務營運與市場趨勢有濃厚興趣，並致力於自我持續成長。

加分條件
• 數據處理能力：精通 Excel 進階函數進行數據分析（如：XLOOKUP, COUNTIFS）。
• 專業經歷：具備 2 至 3 年行政或專案管理相關經驗。
• 培訓與指導經驗：曾有領導、教練或培訓團隊成員以提升整體績效的實績。
• 管理背景：具備主管或管理職經驗者優先考慮。

招募流程：
• 申請資格審核 – 電話面試 – 視訊面試 – 錄取通知
• 招聘流程的確切性質可能會根據具體工作而有所不同，並且可能會因日程安排或其他情況而發生變化。
• 面試時間表和結果將透過電子郵件地址通知應徵人員。

需要考慮的事項：
• 如果空缺職位已填補，則此職位發布可能會在規定的申請結束日期之前關閉。
• 如果發現候選人在申請過程中提交了虛假信息，Coupang 有權撤銷聘用邀請。
• Coupang 不歧視殘疾申請人或退伍軍人。 我們很自豪能為所有申請人提供平等的機會。

jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products About the Customer Solutions Center The Customer Solutions Center is Mastercard’s local product and solutions function, bringing together Mastercard’s products, services, and expertise to address customer and market needs. The team partners closely with account management, sales, regional product teams, technology, and delivery teams to translate Mastercard’s capabilities into customer-relevant solutions and accelerate their successful deployment in the market. To further accelerate our digital agenda, we are expanding the Customer Solutions Center with a Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products, based in Amsterdam and responsible for the Netherlands and Iceland. About the Role As Manager, Product & Solutions – Digital Payments & Consumer Products, you will be a go-to product expert for financial institutions in the Netherlands and Iceland, with a particular focus on accelerating the adoption and deployment of Mastercard’s digital payment solutions. A key focus of the role will be helping issuing institutions design and implement the next generation of digital payment experiences, including Click to Pay, tokenization, authentication, payment passkeys, digital wallets, and related digital capabilities. Alongside Digital Payments, you will support Mastercard’s broader Consumer Products portfolio, helping customers develop compelling consumer payment propositions and ensuring that Mastercard’s digital capabilities are embedded into the overall customer experience. You will work closely with sales, account management, product, and delivery teams to move opportunities from customer discovery and solution design through implementation and market deployment. A strong focus on digital payments, consumer experience, product enablement, and execution will be central to the role. Role and Responsibilities As the customer-facing product and solutions expert for Digital Payments and Consumer Products in the Netherlands and Iceland, you will: Drive digital payment adoption. Accelerate the deployment and adoption of Mastercard digital solutions, including Click to Pay, tokenization, digital wallets, agentic commerce and related capabilities. Lead customer solution discovery. Work with financial institutions to understand their business objectives, consumer needs, technology environment, and digital payment strategy. Shape digital payment solutions. Help customers define their approach, customer journeys, requirements, and implementation plans for Mastercard digital solutions. Support Click to Pay enablement. Help issuers assess their Click to Pay strategy, consumer journeys, dependencies, and implementation readiness. Accelerate tokenization and authentication. Support customers in understanding and deploying Mastercard’s tokenization and authentication capabilities as foundational components of secure and seamless digital payments. Support emerging digital payment capabilities. Build expertise in new Mastercard digital technologies and help customers understand how these capabilities can improve security, convenience, and the overall payment experience. Support Consumer Products. Work with customers and Mastercard product teams to develop relevant consumer payment propositions, ensuring that digital capabilities and consumer product strategies are brought together into a coherent customer experience. Bridge business and technology. Communicate effectively with business leaders, product managers, technology teams, operations teams, and customer-experience specialists, translating complex product and technology topics into clear business and customer implications. Provide pre- and post-sale expertise. Support account managers and sales teams in customer meetings, solution presentations, strategic opportunities, and requests for proposal, and continue to provide product expertise through implementation. Coordinate implementation. Partner with delivery, product, technology, and customer teams to define milestones, identify dependencies, manage risks, and maintain momentum from solution design through deployment. Resolve enablement barriers. Identify recurring product, technology, operational, or customer-experience challenges and coordinate with the appropriate Mastercard teams to support their resolution. Connect local customers with European product teams. Maintain close relationships with Digital Payments, Consumer Products, Product Enablement, and technology teams across Europe to remain current on product capabilities, roadmaps, implementation requirements, and best practices. Support commercialization and adoption. Translate Mastercard capabilities into clear customer value propositions and help develop the enablement approach required to move solutions from opportunity to implementation and adoption. Build internal capability. Share product knowledge, implementation experience, customer insights, and best practices with account teams and the broader Customer Solutions Center. All About You 5+ years of relevant professional experience in product enablement, solution architecture, product management, technical consulting, product commercialization, or a comparable customer-facing role. Strong experience working directly with customers to understand requirements, facilitate workshops, design solutions, and support implementation. Good understanding of the payments ecosystem and the role of issuers, processors, payment networks, digital wallets, merchants, payment service providers, and technology partners. Experience with digital payments, tokenization, digital wallets, e-commerce payments, or related technologies. Ability to translate business and consumer needs into practical product, technology, and customer-experience requirements. Strong understanding of digital customer journeys and user experience, particularly within banking, payments, or commerce. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex product and technology topics clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving sales, account management, product, technology, delivery, and customer teams. Strong planning and organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and dependencies. A proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented working style with the ability to operate effectively in an international and matrixed organization. Fluency in written and spoken English and Dutch. Willingness to travel to support customers and internal collaboration, particularly within the Netherlands, Iceland, and Europe. Desirable Experience Experience working within a bank, issuer, processor, payment network, fintech, digital wallet, or payment-technology provider. Knowledge of digital payment capabilities such as Click to Pay, network tokenization, digital wallets, EMV 3-D Secure, authentication, or payment passkeys. Experience developing or enabling consumer debit, credit, or premium payment propositions. Familiarity with the regulatory, privacy, security, and operational considerations associated with deploying digital payment solutions. Corporate Security Responsibility All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT ASSETS PROTECTION

Assets Protection (AP) teams function to keep our guests, team and brand secure and lead through crisis events. They protect profitable sales by mitigating shortage risks, preventing, and resolving theft and fraud to ensure product is available for our guest. They also build relationships inside and outside of Target, including store leaders and public safety officials, inclusive of law enforcement.

At Target, we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of a Target Security Specialist can provide you with the skills and experience of:

Using intelligence-led tactics to keep team members and guests safe and secure

Crisis response, safety and crowd management; providing support to both guests and team members

•

De-escalation as well as experience with physical security controls and culture

•

Using Target's video surveillance system

•

Timely and accurately documenting cases using case management systems

Create an Easy, Inspiring and Friendly guest experience by delivering on the following commitments:

Greet:

10ft: be friendly – smile, make eye contact, or wave

End every guest transaction with a sincere thank you

Leverage de-escalation tactics and resources when responding to security incidents across the store.

Demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance.

All other duties based on business needs.

You enjoy interacting and helping others - including guests that shop our store and fellow team members you work with.

Effective communication skills

Work both independently and with a team

Manage workload and prioritize tasks independently

Capability to remain focused and composed in a fast-paced environment and accomplish multiple tasks within established timeframes

Climb up and down ladders

Apprehend subjects in accordance with company policy

Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 40 pounds without additional assistance from others

jobs.description: Use Your Power for Purpose Technology impacts everything we do. Pfizer’s digital and ‘data first’ strategy is dedicated to implementing innovative and impactful technology solutions across all functions, from research to manufacturing. Whether you are digitizing drug discovery and development, identifying solutions, or making our work easier and faster, you will be making a significant difference to countless lives. By focusing on these advancements, you contribute to a future where technology enhances every aspect of our operations, ultimately benefiting patients worldwide. Pfizer’s CISO organization delivers proactive cyber defense for Pfizer global enterprise. Our mission is to secure all of Pfizer’s digital information assets ranging from our scientific breakthroughs to the manufacturing floor, and out to the patients we serve. We achieve this mission through a combination of world-class talent, top-tier technologies, industry leading best practices, and the promotion of a cybersecurity ownership culture across the company. As Pfizer continues to advance its digital transformation, delivering a seamless and secure application onboarding experience is critical to enabling business innovation while maintaining strong identity security controls. We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager, Business Integration and Application Onboarding to serve as a strategic partner between ISAM and application owners, guiding teams through the adoption of ISAM solutions such as SailPoint, CyberArk, and other identity security technologies. What You Will Achieve The Senior Manager, Business Integration and Application Onboarding is a key role within the Identity Security and Access Management (ISAM) organization, responsible for driving successful onboarding, integration, and adoption of applications across enterprise identity platforms, including SailPoint, CyberArk, and other IAM technologies. This role serves as the strategic bridge between the ISAM Engineering team and business technology organizations, partnering with application owners, Digital teams, and key stakeholders to translate business needs into secure, scalable identity solutions. The Senior Manager will lead the end-to-end application onboarding lifecycle, ensuring integrations align with security standards, architectural principles, and operational requirements while driving adoption of ISAM capabilities, delivering a seamless customer experience, and advancing Pfizer’s identity security objectives. This role reports to the Director, Identity Governance, and requires a combination of IAM expertise, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and delivery leadership to drive adoption of ISAM capabilities and continuously improve the onboarding experience for application teams. How You Will Achieve It Lead and oversee the end-to-end application onboarding lifecycle for identity and access management platforms, including application discovery, requirements gathering, integration planning, implementation, testing, deployment, and transition to operational support in alignment with Pfizer’s compliance requirements. Serve as the primary relationship owner between the ISAM Engineering team and application owners across Digital organizations, ensuring alignment between business needs, security requirements, technical capabilities, and delivery expectations. Partner with application teams to understand application architectures, identity data requirements, and business processes to define appropriate IAM integration approaches and enable secure access management solutions. Drive adoption of IAM capabilities, including identity lifecycle management, access governance, privileged access management, authentication and directory services, ensuring applications leverage ISAM capabilities effectively. Manage application onboarding roadmaps, priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery milestones across multiple concurrent initiatives to ensure successful execution and stakeholder alignment. Establish and maintain standardized onboarding processes, documentation, governance practices, and communication models to improve scalability, consistency, and customer experience. Support audit, compliance, and risk management activities by ensuring applications are onboarded in accordance with security controls, regulatory expectations, and enterprise IAM standards. Partner with communication teams to drive awareness, adoption, and effective utilization of ISAM capabilities across the enterprise. Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency through automation, process optimization, and platform enhancements. Define and track key performance indicators related to application onboarding, adoption, delivery timelines, operational effectiveness, and continuous improvement. Proven experience leading complex technology implementations, application integrations, or enterprise-scale onboarding programs. Hands-on experience with IAM platforms such as SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), CyberArk, or similar enterprise IAM technologies. Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including: Identity lifecycle management (joiner/mover/leaver processes) Access governance and certification Role-based access control (RBAC) Authentication and authorization concepts Privileged Access Management (PAM) Application integration patterns Strong understanding of enterprise application architectures, including databases, APIs, directories, authentication protocols, and integration methodologies. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, influence stakeholders, and deliver outcomes in a complex enterprise environment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively present complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and senior management. Ability to work collaboratively across various departments and teams, including application owners, engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure technology solutions aligned with business objectives and outcomes. Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience developing and improving operational processes, governance frameworks, and technology adoption strategies. Experience driving automation and process improvements within IAM operations. Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach. Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements) 4+ years of experience focused specifically on leading IAM application onboarding initiatives, integrating enterprise applications with identity security platforms, and delivering scalable identity lifecycle and access management solutions. Experience working within a large global enterprise cybersecurity or CISO organization. Experience implementing or operating SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, CyberArk, or comparable IAM platforms at enterprise scale. Familiarity with security frameworks, audit requirements, and identity-related regulatory controls. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM), SailPoint certifications, or CyberArk certifications. Our team exists to empower DoorDash Mobile engineers. We are the champions of three core pillars: Quality, Velocity, and Efficiency. Ultimately, our goal is to build the supportive infrastructure that allows our fellow engineers to build, ship, and operate apps at massive scale—with confidence and ease. We believe that a great developer experience leads to a great customer experience.

About the Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Mobile Developer Experience team (also known internally as the Mobile Foundations team). In this role, you’ll not only set the technical vision but also nurture the culture required to build world-class mobile applications. Your team will concentrate on one vertical—ZeroKit, which enables rapid mobile prototyping via agents—and two horizontal infrastructure pillars: the iOS and Android monorepos. You will partner with senior engineers and stakeholders across the company to design systems that make our platform faster, more reliable, and more efficient.

You will be a partner to your customers—your fellow engineers—working side-by-side to understand their hurdles and solve their immediate challenges. You’ll also look to the future, anticipating needs so we can deliver solutions before they become blockers. • 7+ years of hands-on software development, and expert proficiency in either Android development or iOS development

About Us

DoorDash Labs, established in 2018, serves as the innovation hub for DoorDash, focusing on developing automation and robotics solutions to enhance last-mile logistics. The team's mission is to create technologies that support and augment human networks, aiming to improve efficiency for Dashers, merchants, and consumers alike. We’re ruthlessly focused on business impact. We are a highly senior team composed of former pioneers from a variety of different robotics industries. As of 2025, DoorDash has completed 10B lifetime deliveries. We’re focused on how to do the next 10B even better.

About The Team

DoorDash Labs is building the future of drone delivery, and you'll be our sole PCB Layout Engineer — owning the physical design of the electronics that get our aircraft flying and keep them safe. You'll take boards from schematic handoff through fabrication, assembly, and bring-up, turning complex mixed-signal designs into manufacturable, flight-ready hardware

About The Role

This is a high-ownership role on a small, highly senior team. You'll be the layout expert the hardware team relies on, partnering daily with electrical, mechanical, power, reliability, and manufacturing engineers. If you love owning the entire layout problem end-to-end — power, RF, and high-speed digital on the same dense board — and want your work flying on real aircraft delivering to real customers, we'd love to talk.

Key Responsibilities

• Own end-to-end PCB layout in Altium Designer — floorplanning, component placement, routing, and release to fabrication and assembly.
• Design dense, multi-layer, controlled-impedance boards that combine power/motor-drive, RF/comms, and high-speed digital on a single flight-ready assembly.
• Optimize layouts for the size, weight, and thermal constraints of airborne hardware while meeting signal- and power-integrity requirements.
• Own DFM/DFA/DFT and produce complete fabrication and assembly packages — stackups, fab/assembly drawings, and Gerber/ODB++ outputs.
• Apply EMI/EMC-aware layout and grounding strategies to meet reliability and regulatory requirements.
• Create and maintain footprint/component libraries and establish layout standards for a fast-growing hardware program.
• Partner closely with EE, mechanical, power, reliability, and manufacturing teams, and support board bring-up, debug, and rework.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent hands-on PCB layout experience.
• 8+ years of hands-on PCB layout experience, with a portfolio of complex, shipped multi-layer boards.
• Expert-level proficiency in Altium Designer.
• Proven ability to own board layout end-to-end, from placement and routing through fabrication and assembly release.
• Strong command of signal integrity, power integrity, and controlled-impedance design (return paths, decoupling, stackup, and plane design).
• Experience with mixed-signal layout spanning power, RF, and high-speed digital domains.
• Working knowledge of DFM/DFA and IPC standards (e.g., IPC-2221/2222, IPC-A-600/610).

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with drone/UAV, aerospace, robotics, or EV (flight or motion) hardware.
• Rigid-flex and flex PCB layout for weight- and space-constrained designs.
• RF and antenna layout (GPS, 2.4/5 GHz, cellular/telemetry) with controlled impedance.
• High-current power, ESC, or motor-drive layout experience.
• ECAD↔MCAD co-design (Altium with SolidWorks or Creo).

Key job responsibilities - Own end-to-end program management for strategic advertising technology initiatives, coordinating delivery across multiple engineering teams, product organizations, and business stakeholders - Drive technical strategy and roadmap alignment by facilitating collaboration between engineering, product, science, and business teams to ensure shared vision and priorities - Lead cross-functional teams through complex technical challenges in areas such as ad serving, campaign management, measurement, and optimization - Establish program governance and accountability mechanisms including metrics, reporting structures, and visibility frameworks that support informed decision-making at senior leadership levels - Identify and mitigate risks across large-scale distributed systems, working proactively with engineering leaders to address technical and operational challenges before they impact service delivery A day in the life In this role, you'll focus on stewarding large-scale technical programs that span our advertising campaign creation technology platform. You might start your day reviewing program metrics and stakeholder feedback on a current initiative, then transition into a technical design review with engineering leaders to evaluate architectural approaches for scaling our ad serving systems. You'll collaborate with product and science teams to align on roadmap priorities, facilitate cross-functional problem-solving sessions to navigate complex technical challenges, and prepare executive summaries for leadership reviews. Your work extends beyond traditional program management—you'll mentor other technical program managers, identify emerging risks in our distributed systems, and champion process improvements that enhance how teams coordinate and deliver. About the team We serve small business owners, sellers, large and sophisticated advertisers, agencies, and integrators who depend on our platform to plan, buy, measure, and optimize their programmatic campaigns. Our team is focused on creating intuitive, strong media buying experiences that help our customers achieve their goals efficiently. We're committed to evolving our product strategy to meet changing advertiser needs while building toward a future where agentic capabilities enhance and streamline key workflows. As a member of this group, you'll work closely with product, engineering, and business partners across Amazon Ads to shape the direction of our platform and deliver meaningful improvements to how campaigns are created and managed and deliver both immediate impact and long-term strategic value.

jobs.description: Position Overview At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Detection and Investigation Analyst Sr., within PNC's Physical Security Operations Center, you will be based in Cleveland Ohio. The Physical Security Operation Center is a 24x7 environment. We are hiring for multiple shifts. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position. The Physical Security Operations Detection & Investigations Analyst is an entry level opportunity and plays a critical role in safeguarding personnel, facilities, assets, and information through the proactive monitoring, detection, assessment, and investigation of physical security events across the enterprise. This position leverages security technologies, operational intelligence, and investigative methodologies to identify potential threats, assess risk, coordinate incident response activities, and support enterprise security objectives. The analyst is responsible for monitoring and managing alarm systems, access control platforms, video surveillance technologies, credentialing systems, and emergency communications while conducting detailed event analysis, evidence preservation, and investigative support activities. The role serves as a central coordination point for security incidents, collaborating with business partners, security personnel, facilities teams, Human Resources, service providers, and local, state, and federal law enforcement agencies to ensure timely and effective resolution of security concerns. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining strict confidentiality and compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and established security procedures. The analyst contributes to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying security trends, operational vulnerabilities, and opportunities to strengthen enterprise physical security controls. This position works closely with the various pillars of the PSOC including Card Access and Badge provisioning, Alarm Monitoring, Video as a Service, Eye in the Sky, and the Physical Security Command Center. The selected candidate may be placed in a primary position within any of these pillars but may also be cross trained to work across other pillars. This position supports a 24/7 security monitoring environment, as such positions will be filled across various primary shifts. Essential Duties and Responsibilities • Review shift information, open incidents, system issues, and pending follow-up items; provide clear shift-change communication to support operational continuity. • Monitor and operate alarm, access-control, CCTV/video management, badge-reader, telephone, and related communication systems. • Receive, document, assess, and respond to security, police, emergency, customer, management, and alarm communications using established dispatch and escalation protocols. • Analyze alarms, video, site data, cardholder information, and event history to determine urgency, risk, operational impact, root cause, and the appropriate response. • Verify reported activity and coordinate notifications, dispatch, emergency assistance, service calls, management escalation, and law-enforcement support as required. • Document incidents, contacts, decisions, actions, responses, and outcomes; prepare accurate reports and maintain dashboards, logs, and records that may support investigations or legal proceedings. • Track incidents and service requests through resolution while managing multiple priorities with accuracy, professionalism, discretion, and accountability. • Retrieve, review, preserve, save, transmit, and post video footage or still images for authorized investigations, legal requests, incidents, and special projects. • Conduct live video monitoring during emergencies, natural disasters, protest activity, special events, and other elevated-risk situations. • Perform camera quality checks, troubleshoot functionality and image-quality issues, and coordinate corrective service when required. • Maintain secure intake, inventory, storage, retrieval, and chain-of-custody controls for hard drives and other archived video media. • Review, verify, create, activate, issue, update, replace, and deactivate employee, contractor, and visitor access credentials in accordance with approved authorization. • Research and resolve discrepancies involving identity documentation, badge requests, access privileges, cardholder records, system exceptions, and access-control transactions. • Perform quality reviews of access-card production, account maintenance, authorizations, documentation, and related staff activity; coordinate corrective actions and maintain controls throughout the credential lifecycle. • Identify unauthorized activity, recurring alarms, process deficiencies, system trends, and security vulnerabilities; recommend corrective controls and continuous improvements. • Escalate high-risk requests, policy exceptions, significant incidents, and potential operational or reputational concerns to management with appropriate recommendations. • Collaborate with security personnel, Human Resources, facilities, production and service teams, business partners, leadership, and law enforcement to resolve requests and incidents. • Comply with physical security standards, internal controls, emergency procedures, confidentiality requirements, access-control policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. • Perform related administrative, clerical, and special-project duties as assigned. Minimum Qualifications • Proficiency with Windows-based computers, Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, web browsers, and electronic reporting tools. • Ability to learn and operate alarm, access-control, video management, camera, badge-reader, telephone, and communication systems. • Minimum typing proficiency of 25 words per minute. • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally and to prepare complete, accurate documentation. • Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive events, exercise sound judgment, protect confidential information, and work effectively with limited supervision. Core Competencies • Analytical Judgment: Identifies anomalies, evaluates risk, determines root cause, prioritizes events, and escalates matters appropriately. • Communication and Customer Service: Communicates clearly, objectively, and professionally with internal and external partners. • Security and Compliance: Applies security policies, dispatch protocols, emergency procedures, confidentiality controls, and evidence-handling practices. • Problem-Solving and Quality Control: Troubleshoots system and process issues, validates information, identifies recurring deficiencies, and recommends corrective action. • Organization and Reliability: Maintains focus, accuracy, discretion, and accountability while managing simultaneous priorities and detailed records. • Collaboration and Independence: Works effectively both independently and as part of a cross-functional team. Work Environment and Physical Requirements This position requires prolonged periods of seated work in a security monitoring environment, sustained attention to multiple screens and communication channels, and the ability to respond calmly and accurately to routine and urgent events. Company Introduction

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery,” which offers next‑day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, as well as “Rocket Overseas,” which provides free international delivery on millions of best‑selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

Role Overview

This dual-function role provides critical operational support across both Global Mobility Taiwan (40%) and Global Business Travel (60%). Operating as an individual contributor, you will serve as the primary operational point of contact in Taiwan, managing local vendor relationships, travel logistics, payment processes, and mobility cases. You will split your time between managing mobility compliance and providing hands-on travel and accommodation coordination to support major strategic initiatives (including the CLS Project, Taiwan Logistics Centre expansion, and Rocket Delivery operations) while maintaining service continuity for our workforce.

Key Responsibilities

Global Business Travel Coordination (60%)

• Vendor & Accommodation Management: Act as the primary local point of contact with hotels and travel suppliers across Taiwan (particularly in the Taoyuan region). Conduct local, Mandarin-language communications to build on-the-ground relationships, negotiate long-stay room blocks, and secure competitive rates.
• Travel & Project Logistics: Source and coordinate accommodations, travel requests, and schedule changes for Korea-based personnel and local team members traveling across Northern, Central, and Southern Taiwan in support of major startup initiatives and temporary assignments.
• Traveler Support & Escalation: Serve as the local escalation point to troubleshoot urgent traveler issues, manage accommodation changes, provide guidance aligned with company Travel Policy, and deliver high-quality traveler support.
• Cross-Border & Operational Coordination: Collaborate directly with the Seoul-based GBT core team to bridge time zone, language, and market knowledge gaps. Work alongside internal teams (Global Mobility, Immigration, Procurement, Finance, Payroll) and external partners (travel agencies, hotels, airlines).
• Financial & Administrative Operations: Handle travel-related expense processing, vendor payments, and invoice transactions. Maintain GBT databases, benefit records, lease agreements, and system updates.
• Process Improvement & Reporting: Identify efficiencies in administrative workflows and provide reporting insights to support operational decision-making.

Global Mobility Operations (40%)

• Case Management & Administration: Provide end-to-end administrative and operational support for day-to-day mobility operations, case management, relocation activities, and assignment administration.
• Immigration & Compliance Support: Assist with employee immigration processes, work authorization, visa applications/renewals, work permit processing, and compliance-related tracking.
• Stakeholder Communication: Maintain clear consultation and communications with internal stakeholders, employees, and managers regarding mobility policies, relocation schedules, and assignment details.
• Operational Continuity: Maintain high service level standards and operational workflows to support business continuity across Taiwan.

Key Requirements & Qualifications

• Location & Language: Based in Taipei, Taiwan. Fluent in Mandarin (essential for local vendor negotiations) and proficient in English (for regional stakeholder alignment).
• Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in global mobility/immigration, corporate travel management, hotel procurement, hospitality coordination, or HR operations.
• Vendor Management & Negotiation: Proven negotiation skills and background in managing local accommodation providers and travel suppliers.
• Operational & Financial Skills: Strong attention to detail with practical experience handling vendor payments, expense tracking, and database/record management.
• Problem Solving & Adaptability: Excellent organizational and multi-tasking abilities to independently prioritize and manage split responsibilities across two active operational functions. High customer-service orientation and quick troubleshooting skills.
• Market Knowledge: Deep familiarity with Taiwan’s local travel landscape, hospitality market, and business travel logistics.
